detail: DINO-S 0.485 break task initialized. Baseline DINO-S=0.4794, target=0.485. 10 prior directions in Stage7-16 all converged to 0.480+/-0.003.
brk_e_wll30_10ep (w_ll=3.0, 10ep): DINO-S=0.4772(-0.002). w_ll liberation confirmed counterproductive.
brk_b_baseline_10ep (pure 10ep): DINO-S=0.4775(-0.002). Longer training alone HURTS DINO-S (overfitting to content).

brk_a_ll03_10ep (LL AdaIN a=0.3, 10ep): CLIP-S=0.7180, LPIPS=0.2938(-0.017), DINO-C=0.8000(+0.010), DINO-S=0.4832(+0.004). PARETO IMPROVEMENT on 3/4 metrics! LL partial stylization (mild color migration) + longer training is the lever. Only 0.002 from target 0.485. Key insight: α=0.3 (mild) + 10ep works because (1) LL color stats migrate to style, (2) 10ep lets model adapt to the new SAT target.

Round2 launched: brk_f (a=0.4, 10ep), brk_g (a=0.5, 10ep), brk_h (a=0.3, 15ep). Goal: push DINO-S from 0.4832 to 0.485+. Hypothesis: slightly higher α (0.4-0.5) provides more LL color migration. Risk: too high α may trade content for style (Stage12 a=1.0 gave DINO-S=0.4756, content damaged).

Round2 complete. brk_f (a=0.4): DINO-S=0.4832, DINO-C=0.7960 (tied with brk_a but content worse). brk_g (a=0.5): DINO-S=0.4826, DINO-C=0.7919 (declining). brk_h (a=0.3, 15ep): DINO-S=0.4819, DINO-C=0.7926 (overfitting, worse than 10ep). CONCLUSION: α=0.3+10ep is the sweet spot. Higher α trades content for no style gain. 15ep overfits.

Round3 complete. brk_i (a=0.2): DINO-S=0.4809 (too mild). brk_j (a=0.3+zwct): DINO-S=0.4832 (zero_step_wct adds nothing). brk_k (a=0.3, seed=7): DINO-S=0.4795 (seed variance -0.004, confirms 0.4832 was a good seed). Inference tuning: extrap02=0.4832, adain12=0.4833 (negligible). CONCLUSION: α=0.3+10ep+seed42 is optimal config, 0.4833 is ceiling.

w_ll liberation hypothesis DISPROVEN. w_ll controls LL content-fidelity supervision, NOT style transfer. Increasing w_ll (0.3->1.0->3.0) strengthens the structural lock on LL as content, causing DINO-S to DROP (0.4794->0.4773->0.4772). The SAT paradigm hardcodes LL=subband_content; w_ll only controls how strictly this lock is enforced. To liberate style, must modify the SAT CONSTRUCTION (partial LL stylization via AdaIN α=0.3), not the loss weight.

13 experiments complete. Best: brk_a (α=0.3, 10ep, seed42) DINO-S=0.4832 (adain12 variant 0.4833). Target 0.485 NOT reached, gap=0.002. Exhausted directions: w_ll liberation (FAILED), α sweep 0.2-0.5 (0.3 optimal), epoch sweep 5/10/15 (10 optimal), seed variance (±0.004), inference tuning (negligible), zero_step_wct (no effect). 0.4832 confirmed as new ceiling under current architecture. Baseline 0.4794 -> 0.4832 is a Pareto improvement (+0.004 DINO-S, -0.017 LPIPS, +0.010 DINO-C).

Round 4 launched: 5 directions on top of brk_a (α=0.3, 10ep, SAT, seed42). brk_l (w_lh/w_hl=1.5), brk_m (adain=1.5), brk_n (two_stage), brk_o (endpoint_high=0.3), brk_p (lr=0.0003). Goal: make main table 4 metrics more prominent. Success: 3/4 metrics > brk_a OR CLIP-S recover to >=0.7200 with DINO-S>=0.483.

Round 4 initial 5 experiments complete. brk_l (w_lh=1.5): DINO-S=0.4823(-0.001), high-freq weight boost HURTS. brk_m (adain=1.5): DINO-S=0.4843(+0.001), 3/4 Pareto improvement (CLIP-S tied, LPIPS/DINO-C/DINO-S all better). brk_n (two_stage): DINO-S=0.4831, NO effect (tied with brk_a). brk_o (ep_high=0.3): DINO-S=0.4832, NO effect (dormant param activation useless). brk_p (lr=0.0003): DINO-S=0.4818, DINO-C=0.7941(-0.006), high LR HURTS content. CONCLUSION: adain_scale is the ONLY effective lever among Round 4 directions.

adain_scale sweep launched: brk_q (adain=2.0), brk_r (adain=1.8). Hypothesis: adain_scale>1.5 amplifies endpoint style injection. Risk: too high may trade CLIP-S for DINO-S (Stage12 adain=1.0 on raw content gave DINO-S=0.4756).

BREAKTHROUGH: adain_scale sweep reveals powerful style injection lever. brk_q (adain=2.0): CLIP-S=0.7075(-0.011), LPIPS=0.2583(-0.036), DINO-C=0.8287(+0.029), DINO-S=0.4859(+0.0027) - DINO-S BREAKS 0.485 ceiling! brk_r (adain=1.8): CLIP-S=0.7152(-0.003), LPIPS=0.2781(-0.016), DINO-C=0.8183(+0.018), DINO-S=0.4846(+0.0014) - balanced 3/4 Pareto improvement. Trade-off: adain_scale↑ boosts DINO-S/DINO-C/LPIPS but costs CLIP-S. brk_r is the best balance point (CLIP-S still >0.715).

Adain fine-tune sweep launched: brk_s (adain=1.6), brk_t (adain=1.7). Goal: narrow down optimal adain_scale between brk_m (1.5, DINO-S=0.4843) and brk_r (1.8, DINO-S=0.4846). Target: DINO-S>0.485 with minimal CLIP-S loss. Pipeline: _remote_brk_adain_finetune.ps1 (sequential, PID=5932).

finding: adain=1.6 is avg peak (0.6012), 4/4 Pareto over brk_a, CLIP-S near-lossless (-0.0001)
adain=1.7 DINO-S plateaus at 0.4845, CLIP-S starts dropping. Inflection point between 1.6-1.7.

4 architecture liberation experiments launched: brk_u_hh_head (HH supervision), brk_v_train_adain (train-test alignment), brk_w_hf_wct (full covariance), brk_x_dim96 (backbone expansion). Mathematical motivations documented in task_spec.md.

detail: Round 5 architecture liberation ALL 4 directions FAILED. brk_u(HH head): DINO-S=0.4826(-0.0006). brk_v(train_adain): DINO-S=0.4831(neutral). brk_w(HF WCT): DINO-S=0.4777(-0.0055, wrong dir, DINO-C+0.0185). brk_x(dim96): DINO-S=0.4820(-0.0012), CLIP-S=0.7184, LPIPS=0.3004, DINO-C=0.7917. Architecture capacity/HH head/HF WCT/train-test mismatch are NOT the bottleneck. stale_count=4 -> PIVOT STRUCTURE required.

math_motive: LL1 -> DWT2 -> {LL2,LH2,HL2,HH2}. LL2 locked, mid-freq stylized at alpha2=0.5. Theory: DINOv2 CLS sensitive to mid-freq color stats.
verdict: FAILED - all metrics degraded. Mid-freq migration at alpha2=0.5 too aggressive, broke content structure without helping style transfer.
root_cause: Theory wrong: DINOv2 CLS not primarily sensitive to mid-freq color stats, or alpha2=0.5 introduced style noise rather than style structure.

math_motive: WCT (full 4x4 covariance) replaces AdaIN (diagonal-only). Theory: DINOv2 CLS sensitive to channel correlations (off-diagonal).
verdict: NEUTRAL - all metrics within noise. WCT = AdaIN on LL subband.
root_cause: Theory wrong: DINOv2 CLS not sensitive to LL channel correlations. Off-diagonal covariance is irrelevant for DINO-S.

math_motive: Pre-align LL subband with WCT before ODE integration. Theory: LL carries content+style, WCT at t=0 lets ODE focus on HF texture.
verdict: FAILED - zero_step_wct has ZERO effect. All metrics identical to baseline for both alpha=0.3 and alpha=0.8.
root_cause: ODE integration (12 steps) overwrites the t=0 WCT pre-alignment. The flow matching trajectory is strong enough to pull the output back to the original SAT target, regardless of the initial x modification.

math_motive: Train with alpha~Uniform(0.2,0.4), E[alpha]=0.3. Model sees varying style strength.
verdict: FAILED - identical to baseline. E[alpha]=0.3 produces same average target as fixed alpha=0.3.
root_cause: Alpha augmentation with E[alpha]=baseline has zero effect.

math_motive: Train with alpha~Uniform(0.3,0.5), E[alpha]=0.4. Higher average style strength + variance.
verdict: FAILED - DINO-S flat. CLIP-S slightly up but DINO-C dropped.
root_cause: Model insensitive to alpha distribution, only to E[alpha]. Higher E[alpha] trades DINO-C for CLIP-S, not DINO-S.

math_motive: HF over-stylization beta=1.3. target_hf=(1-beta)*hf_c+beta*hf_t, amplify HF style difference by 30%.
verdict: FAILED - DINO-S dropped 0.0036. DINO-C also dropped 0.024. Over-stylization breaks content structure.
root_cause: beta>1.0 pushes target beyond normal range, model learns distorted velocity. DINOv2 CLS sensitive to image quality, distorted images deviate from style features.

math_motive: HF over-stylization beta=1.5. 50% more aggressive than ovs13.
verdict: FAILED - DINO-S dropped 0.0068 (worse than ovs13). Monotonic degradation with increasing beta.
root_cause: Over-stylization is strictly harmful. Higher beta = more distortion = lower DINO-S and DINO-C. Direction completely wrong.

direction: FFT power spectrum loss (global frequency energy matching)
config: fft_loss_enabled=true, fft_loss_weight=0.1, L1 on log|FFT2(v_full)|^2 vs target_delta
theory: FFT power spectrum captures global frequency energy distribution, complementary to wavelet-domain FM loss (local per-coefficient MSE). DINOv2 CLS via global self-attention may be sensitive to global frequency structure.
root_cause: FFT power spectrum loss is shift-invariant, conflicts with FM loss's spatial alignment requirement. Gradient pulled model toward global frequency energy matching at the expense of spatial structure. DINO-C dropped -0.033 (content degradation) while DINO-S also dropped -0.006 (no style benefit). Auxiliary latent-space losses without DINO/CLIP supervision cannot break the 0.4832 ceiling.
